reason: 该插件的主要用途是将微信 ilink bot 的私聊消息接入 DSH agent 会话并回传回复，属于外部通信服务集成；说明书强调扫码绑定账号、按天会话管理、热插拔开关、HTTP API 与命令控制，以及文本与媒体（图片/文件/视频）的收发与持久化，表明其是用户面向的微信桥接与会话互通工具。未体现代码生成、数据分析或可视化主线能力。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DSH 中桥接微信(ilink bot)私聊与 AI 会话，支持扫码绑定账号、运行时启停，并可在聊天中同步文本与相关文件内容。
summaries.en: This plugin bridges WeChat (ilink bot) private messages into DSH sessions, supports account linking and runtime enable/disable, and enables text plus media flow between chats and the agent.

capabilities: bridging WeChat ilink bot private messages into DSH agent sessions
persisting account/session state and offsets in local JSON state files
sending and receiving text/media through WeChat bot APIs and file upload/download flow
runtime control via slash commands, settings UI, and hot-reload configuration
exposing plugin HTTP endpoints for account and status management

reasons.code: The plugin explicitly describes polling/syncing WeChat ilink bot updates and sending replies via bot APIs.
It persists bridge credentials and conversation state in local files under ~/.dsh/wechat-bridge, including state.json and session/media artifacts.
It includes settings UI, slash commands, and HTTP endpoints for account login/enable/disable and bridge control, enabling user-facing operational actions.
